subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete sentence.
stimulus: There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. The winners of these i. in the list in 1969 for the first time. b. This prize is given ii. a large sum of money c. Economics was added iii. amongst all the winners. d. Do you know how iv. prizes are talked about throughout the world. e. This man was none v. to persons with most outstanding contribution in physics. vi. the Nobel Prize was started? vii. but Alfred Nobel.
guide_solution: (a + iv) : The winners of these prizes are talked about throughout the world. (b + v) : This prize is given to persons with most outstanding. (c + i) : Economics was added in the list in 1969 for the first time. (d + vi) : Do you know how the Nobel Prize was started? (e + vii) : This man was none but Alfred Nobel.
